features.name: Multi-company support through Dataverse shared execution variable
features.description: Allows virtual table plugin to use BC Company ID shared execution variable to override both global and user-specific company settings, enabling multiple Power Pages portals to target different Business Central companies.

features.name: Anonymous read-only access for external users without licensing
features.description: Enables external or unlicensed users to access Business Central data through Power Pages portals without signing in, such as for B2B customer portals.
caveats: user does not need to be licensed

features.name: Authenticated access for external users after registration
features.description: Allows external or unlicensed users to access Business Central data through Power Pages after signing in and registering, such as in customer onboarding or vendor bidding processes.
caveats: user does not need to be licensed

features.name: Authenticated access for internal licensed users
features.description: Enables licensed Business Central employees to access Business Central virtual tables data through Power Pages after signing in, with same licensing requirements as Business Central.

features.name: Custom Dataverse mapping plugin for company targeting
features.description: Allows creation of custom Dataverse mapping plugins and tables that intercept virtual table access to set BC Company ID for specific combinations of users, Power Apps, and Power Pages portals.

features.name: Global company setting for virtual tables
features.description: Standard setting that applies to all users and apps using virtual tables, targeting a specific Business Central company by default.

features.name: User-specific company setting override
features.description: Allows individual users to override the global company setting, targeting a specific Business Central company that applies to all apps and Power Pages portals for that user.

features.name: Portal ID retrieval from Power Pages URL
features.description: Ability to obtain the portal ID from Power Pages portal URLs by appending underscore Services slash to the URL, used for mapping table configuration.
